messages:
sam: Quick heads up — packaging job for private v2.7.1 produced a mismatched checksum for the offline mirror tarball. Holding signing until we triage.
maria: Which artifact exactly? path + expected hash pls.
dmitri: Likely the mirror re-compressed gzip level. Can you paste the sha output?
maria: Ran locally:
```
$ sha256sum build/output/installer-v2.7.1-offline.tar.gz
0a3f6b2c9d4e8c7f9b1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef  installer-v2.7.1-offline.tar.gz
```
But the manifest expects: `c1b2a3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789ab`
sam: Exact — manifest (release-manifests/private/v2.7.1.json) has that c1b2... value. Deploy-bot started sign job but it errored out. Noticed the tar was built on CI with default tar flags.
dmitri: That explains it. Tar ordering / mtime changes will flip the checksum. We should use deterministic tar flags. Rebuild with:
```
$ tar --sort=name --mtime='UTC 1970-01-01' --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -czf installer-v2.7.1-offline.tar.gz payload/
```
and then verify sha256.
jen: Are we ok to abort signing window until we confirm? We have the private delivery window 03:00–05:00 UTC tonight.
lena: KMS signer rotation is scheduled 04:15 UTC — if we delay signing past that we need to re-run signer key affinity. Prefer to keep within first hour.
deploy-bot: packaging-job #8423 status: completed -> signed=false, uploaded=false, checksum_mismatch=true :warning:
maria: I can re-run packaging with deterministic flags on a stable builder (same image) now and push a new artifact to the staging mirror. Will validate against manifest hash afterwards.
sam: If you push a new artifact, don't overwrite the manifest yet. We'll validate and then update manifest + run cosign. Also add a release note line in the notes draft: "Regenerated offline tar with deterministic packaging to fix checksum variance." Keep it terse.
dmitri: Also double-check gzip levels: `gzip -n` flag when creating gz to avoid storing original filename/mtime. For tar+gz built pipeline we should set `GZIP=-n` env when running `tar -czf`.
maria: ack — will run `GZIP=-n tar --sort=name --mtime='UTC 1970-01-01' ...` and paste new sha.
jen: Decision call: try rebuild + sign within the 03:00–04:00 UTC window. If not cleared by 02:45 UTC, we abort and fall back to shipping previous pinned manifest (private-v2.7.0), and open a postmortem. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: Agreed. Also schedule a short canary in us-west for the patched artifact before wide delivery. I'll update the rollout checklist.
lena: I'll extend signer TTL handshake window by +10m starting 03:50 UTC in case we run late, but we should avoid that.
maria: New run done — sha now:
```
$ sha256sum build/output/installer-v2.7.1-offline.tar.gz
c1b2a3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789ab  installer-v2.7.1-offline.tar.gz
```
matches manifest.
deploy-bot: packaging-job #8424 status: staging-uploaded=true, signed=false
sam: OK — Maria, please hand to ops for cosign. @deploy-bot kick signing job when ops ack.
jen: Ops: can you cosign and mark signed before 03:50 UTC? If anything blocks, call the rollback by 02:45 as planned.
ops: on it, will cosign once manifest + artifact validated. ETA 00:40 UTC.
sam: Great. After cosign we'll push release notes and flip the private-rc tag for canary. Thanks all — I'll post a brief in release channel when signed. :white_check_mark:
